instructions.name: burn_token
docs: Burn long-yield-carry tokens and redeem collateral.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays SOL rent when async-path PDAs are created; must authorize lamport debits.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The yToken mint. Mutable because the burn CPI decrements total supply.

accounts.name: user_token_account
docs: User's yToken ATA — source of the burn. The user is the authority.

accounts.name: user_collateral_account
docs: User's collateral ATA — destination of the redeemed collateral.

accounts.name: collateral_token_account
docs: Token PDA's collateral reserve — source of the collateral payout, and
the destination for the collateral withdrawal in the liquidity path.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for yToken operations (Burn).

accounts.name: collateral_token_program
docs: Token program for collateral operations (Transfer).

instructions.name: cancel_async_burn
docs: Cancel a timed-out FIFO-head async burn request while its epoch is still open.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Validated against the payer stored on the request at creation time.

accounts.name: epoch_rent_recipient
docs: Must match `redemption_epoch.header.payer`.

instructions.name: claim_incentives
docs: Claim lending-platform farm incentives and deposit them into the
token's carry position via the yielding bank.

accounts.name: token_incentive_ata
docs: Token PDA's ATA for the reward mint — receives rewards from the claim CPI.

accounts.name: yielding_bank
docs: Required only on the debt-mint branch. Self-pointer check happens
inline at the start of `settle_debt_branch`.

accounts.name: yielding_bank_incentive_ata
docs: Yielding bank's ATA for the reward mint — receives the transfer on the
debt-mint branch.

accounts.name: incentive_oracle
docs: `incentive_oracle_type`, which validates feed identity. Required on
the debt-mint and collateral-mint branches.

accounts.name: fee_wallet
docs: Required on the fee-wallet branch.

instructions.name: close_cpi_plan
docs: Close an orphaned CPI plan PDA and return its rent to the manager.
CPI plan accounts normally auto-close via `close = manager` when
`rebalance_token` succeeds. This instruction reclaims rent from any
plans that were left open due to a failed or interrupted transaction.

accounts.name: manager
docs: Receives the reclaimed rent. Must be the original payer of this CPI plan.

instructions.name: collect_fees
docs: Collect accrued protocol fees from a token.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must match either the token's `curator()` or the program-level `PROTOCOL_ADMIN`.
If the signer is `PROTOCOL_ADMIN`, the protocol fee bucket and wallet are used
(even when that key is also the curator). Otherwise, when the signer is the
curator only, the curator bucket and curator fee wallet are used.

accounts.name: fee_wallet
docs: Fee wallet that receives the minted yTokens. Must match the
`curator_fee_wallet()` wallet when signed by the curator, or
`protocol_fee_wallet()` when signed by PROTOCOL_ADMIN.
SAFETY: pubkey compared to expected fee wallet before mint_to.

accounts.name: fee_wallet_token_account
docs: Fee wallet's yToken ATA — created on first collection, reused thereafter

accounts.name: donation_wallet
docs: Donation wallet — receives [`DONATION_FEE_PCT_BPS`] of protocol fee
yTokens when signed by PROTOCOL_ADMIN. Always passed and validated;
curator collections do not mint to it.

accounts.name: donation_wallet_token_account
docs: Donation wallet's yToken ATA — created on first protocol collection.

instructions.name: collect_interest
docs: Realize accrued yield from a carry position.

accounts.name: redemption_oracle
docs: Oracle account for the yielding bank's default redemption mint —
refreshed at the top of the handler so share accounting and the phase 4
slippage check all use a live price basis that matches what the SDK
planner read when sizing the swap input.

accounts.name: collateral_token_account
docs: Token PDA's collateral ATA — final destination for the swapped collateral

accounts.name: yb_collateral_token_account
docs: Yielding bank's collateral ATA — receives the swap output before the
handler transfers the delta into the token's collateral ATA.

accounts.name: protocol_fee_wallet_collateral_account
docs: Protocol fee wallet's collateral ATA — receives the management fee (the
ungated fee on realized yield). Paid entirely to the protocol; there is no
curator split on the management fee.
Address is the ATA of `TokenRoles::protocol_fee_wallet()` for this collateral mint.

accounts.name: yb_redemption_token_account
docs: YB's ATA for the default redemption mint — snapshotted before and after
swap CPIs to verify only this asset was sold.
default_redemption_mint and the yielding bank PDA.

instructions.name: create_cpi_plan
docs: Create a temporary zero-copy CPI plan account for a later instruction.

instructions.name: create_token
docs: Create a new token and initialize its configuration.

accounts.name: curator
docs: Curator that will own this token. Must be in `WHITELISTED_CURATORS`.
Pays for account rent.

accounts.name: admin_role
docs: Admin multisig. `None` means "use the feature-gated default".

accounts.name: manager_role
docs: Manager ops wallet. `None` means "use default".

accounts.name: curator_fee_wallet
docs: Curator fee wallet. `None` means "use default".

accounts.name: cb_controller_role
docs: Circuit-breaker activator. `None` means "use default".

accounts.name: mint
docs: yToken mint — must be pre-created with its authority set to the token PDA
and freeze authority set to None. This allows the caller to set mint metadata
(name, symbol, icon) before registering the token with the program.

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: The underlying collateral mint (e.g. wSOL)

accounts.name: collateral_token_account
docs: Token PDA's account for holding unlent collateral reserves

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Token program for the yToken mint

accounts.name: collateral_token_program
docs: Token program for the collateral mint

instructions.name: create_token_lending_position
docs: Register a new lending position for a token.

accounts.name: user_account
docs: The lending position's user/authority account.

accounts.name: collateral_reserve
docs: The lending position's collateral reserve/bank account.

accounts.name: debt_oracle
docs: Oracle for the lending position's debt asset.

instructions.name: create_yielding_bank
docs: Create a new yielding bank for a base mint.

accounts.name: curator
docs: Curator that will own this yielding bank. Must be in `WHITELISTED_CURATORS`.
Pays for account rent.

accounts.name: admin_role
docs: Admin multisig. `None` means "use the feature-gated default".

accounts.name: manager_role
docs: Manager ops wallet. `None` means "use default".

accounts.name: cb_controller_role
docs: Circuit-breaker activator. `None` means "use default".

accounts.name: default_redemption_mint
docs: The mint used as the default source when redeeming from the bank.
Validated as a real SPL Token / Token-2022 mint by Anchor deserialization.

accounts.name: base_mint_token_account
docs: Base mint ATA owned by the yielding bank PDA — created so refresh
can always read the token balance for the base asset.

instructions.name: create_yielding_bank_allocation
docs: Add a new asset holding or external position to a yielding bank.

accounts.name: allocation_mint
docs: Mint for the new asset holding.

instructions.name: credit_unlent_to_redemption_epoch
docs: Credit already-unlent collateral reserves to a redemption epoch.

instructions.name: decrease_carry_position
docs: Reduce a carry position and return freed collateral.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The manager role check is enforced at runtime because the token account
is supplied via `remaining_accounts`.

instructions.name: deposit_unlent_collateral
docs: Lend idle collateral from a token into a lending position.

accounts.name: collateral_token_account
docs: Token PDA's collateral reserve — balance is checked before and
after the deposit CPI to derive the actual deposited amount.

accounts.name: lending_position_user_account
docs: The lending position's user/authority account on the lending protocol
(e.g. Kamino obligation). Used to refresh the position after deposit.

accounts.name: lending_position_collateral_reserve
docs: The lending protocol's collateral reserve account. Used to convert
cTokens to underlying liquidity during the post-deposit refresh.

instructions.name: increase_carry_position
docs: Increase a carry position using borrowed funds.

accounts.name: manager
docs: via `remaining_accounts`, so the role check is enforced at runtime in
the handler rather than by an Anchor constraint here.

instructions.name: mint_token
docs: Deposit collateral and mint long-yield-carry tokens.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The yToken mint — authority is the token PDA

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: Collateral mint (for TransferChecked decimals validation)

accounts.name: user_collateral_account
docs: User's collateral ATA (source of deposit)

accounts.name: user_token_account
docs: User's yToken ATA — must be created before calling this instruction

accounts.name: collateral_token_account
docs: Token PDA's collateral reserve

accounts.name: token_program

accounts.name: collateral_token_program
docs: Token program for collateral operations (TransferChecked)

instructions.name: process_async_burn
docs: Process the next FIFO async burn request in an epoch.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Validated against the payer stored on the request at creation time.

accounts.name: user
docs: collateral is wrapped SOL; otherwise unused except for identity binding.

accounts.name: user_collateral_account
docs: User's collateral ATA — required when collateral is not wrapped SOL.

accounts.name: request_collateral_account

before it is swapped into the debt asset.

accounts.name: collateral_reserve

types.name: AmountRateLimit
docs: Rolling amount rate limit using a tumbling time window.
Tracks cumulative usage within a fixed-length window. When the window
expires, the counter resets automatically on the next operation.
The rate limit is only enforced when both `max_amount > 0` and
`window_duration_secs > 0`. The default (all zeros) means no rate limiting.

fields.name: max_amount
docs: Maximum cumulative amount allowed within one window.

fields.name: window_duration_secs
docs: Length of the rate-limit window in seconds.

fields.name: amount_used
docs: Cumulative amount consumed in the current window.

fields.name: window_start_ts
docs: Unix timestamp when the current window started.

types.name: AssetAllocationConfig
docs: Configuration for the collateral or debt side of an external lending position.

types.name: AssetConfig
docs: Configuration for adding a new yield-bearing asset holding.
Fields derivable from the mint account (`mint`, `decimals`, `token_program`)
are provided separately — the mint is a named account on the instruction,
and the handler reads decimals/token_program from it.

fields.name: mint
docs: The mint of the asset (e.g. base stablecoin, LST, or receipt token)

fields.name: amount

fields.name: oracle
docs: Oracle account for price resolution

fields.name: decimals

fields.name: external_liquidity
docs: In some cases, an asset will not have all funds sitting in the PDA's token account.
We track the source type and read the accounts accordingly to know the full amount
owed to the yielding bank onchain.

fields.name: time_created
docs: Unix timestamp when this holding was registered.

fields.name: payer
docs: Account that funded the request PDA rent. Receives the rent back when
the request is closed during `process_async_burn`.

fields.name: max_amount
docs: Maximum cumulative burn amount allowed within one window (0 to disable).

fields.name: window_duration_secs
docs: Length of the rate-limit window in seconds (0 to disable).

types.name: BurnTokenParams
docs: Instruction params for burning yTokens.
Use [`BurnTokenParams::Sync`] when unlent collateral is sufficient without
allocating redemption epoch PDAs. Use [`BurnTokenParams::Async`] when async
fallback PDAs are passed — required when reserves may be insufficient at
execution time.

fields.name: prerequisite_cpis
docs: Optional prerequisite CPIs (e.g. Kamino reserve / obligation refresh)
executed before the claim CPI.

fields.name: token_ix_refs
docs: CPI refs for the single claim-incentives action.

fields.name: lending_position_index
docs: Lending position index whose farm rewards are being claimed. Used for
platform routing and timelock enforcement.

fields.name: incentive_oracle_type
docs: Oracle type for pricing the claimed reward when the incentive mint
matches the lending position's debt mint or the token's collateral
mint. Ignored on the fee-wallet branch.

types.name: CollateralBuffer
docs: Runtime state for collateral reserved for loss coverage or gradual release.
Mint/burn holder fees and loss retained from async burners add collateral to
this buffer. Buffered collateral is physically held in the reserve and
**subtracted from the price basis**
(`price = (collateral − buffered_collateral) / total_supply`)
so the price stays flat at absorption time. `refresh_token` then releases the
buffer gradually, which grows the price numerator and lifts the price smoothly
rather than in a spike.
Denominating the buffer in collateral (rather than phantom supply) keeps each
contribution a fixed nominal amount: it does not ride the token's appreciation
while parked, and ongoing yield flows fully to holders during the drip window.
A configurable APY target and hard cap
(`TokenFees::collateral_buffer_target_apy_bps`) releases enough of the buffer
on each refresh to bring annualized price growth up to the target without
exceeding it. A negative reference-window APY or a zero target parks the
buffer. A material carry deficit also parks the buffer and freezes the APY
reference so depeg volatility cannot release protection or poison the
eventual recovery baseline.
`recollateralize_loss` consumes this buffer before the interest-drip buffer
and ordinary collateral backing.

3. Using `lengths` to slice the indices for each individual CPI
# Example
For 2 CPIs where CPI 0 needs 10 accounts and CPI 1 needs 8 accounts:

CPI 0 uses indices[0..10]

types.name: InterestDripConfig
docs: Runtime state for the collected-interest "drip".
When `drip_duration_secs` is non-zero, `collect_interest` does not apply the
realized yield to the token price immediately. The collateral physically
arrives in the reserve (so TVL and solvency are unaffected), but it is
parked here as `collateral_interest_collected` and **subtracted from the
price basis** — the same mechanism as `CollateralBuffer` — so the price stays
~flat at collection time.
Each release then follows a rolling linear schedule: the buffer drains
proportionally to elapsed time over `[last_drip_ts, drip_end_ts]`. A new
collection folds the un-released remainder in with the fresh interest and
restarts the window at `now + drip_duration_secs`.
`min_apy_bps` is a floor on annualized price growth (measured against the
shared [`super::ApyReference`]): when the linear schedule alone would leave
growth below the floor, enough extra buffer is released to reach it.
`drip_duration_secs == 0` (the zero-copy default used by legacy tokens)
disables buffering entirely — collected interest is absorbed into the price
immediately. `create_token` overrides this with the protocol default for new
tokens.
`recollateralize_loss` may consume this buffer after exhausting the
collateral buffer, before ordinary collateral backing.

into the price. Subtracted from the collateral in the price basis.

fields.name: last_drip_ts

fields.name: drip_end_ts
docs: Timestamp at which the current schedule has fully released the buffer.

fields.name: drip_duration_secs
docs: Config: window (seconds) over which newly collected interest is
released into the price. `0` absorbs collections immediately.

fields.name: min_apy_bps
docs: Config: floor (bps) for annualized price growth during release; the
schedule accelerates past its linear rate when growth against the APY
reference falls below this. `0` disables the floor.

types.name: PerformanceFeeConfig
docs: High-water-mark accounting for the global performance fee.
The performance fee (`TokenFees::performance_fee_bps`) is charged on token
*price* appreciation above `high_water_mark`. Because the token price is
denominated in the collateral mint (not USD) and already excludes unrealized
carry surplus, this taxes only realized yield that has actually lifted the
price — never collateral-oracle moves or uncollected carry.
On each `refresh_token`, after the final price is written,
`Token::crystallize_performance_fee` compares the price to `high_water_mark`:
• price ≤ mark → no fee; the mark is unchanged (a drawdown never reverses a
fee, and a recovery back toward the mark is fee-free).
• price > mark → the fee is taken on the gain via a dilution mint into the
pending fee buckets, then the mark advances to the pre-dilution peak.
`high_water_mark == 0` marks an unseeded account (freshly created, or a
legacy account that predates this struct — the trailing bytes decode as
zero). The first crystallization seeds the mark to the current price without
charging, so no historical appreciation is retroactively taxed.
Layout note: this struct occupies bytes that were previously part of
`Token::_padding2`, so deployed accounts decode it as all-zero (unseeded).

docs: Authority for yielding-bank config updates and circuit-breaker deactivation.
Intended to be a multisig in production. Rotatable by the current admin via
`update_yielding_bank_config`.

fields.name: manager
docs: Ops wallet authorized to run manager-gated instructions on this bank
(rebalance_yielding_bank, create_yielding_bank_allocation). Rotatable
via `update_yielding_bank_config`.

fields.name: cb_controller
docs: Emergency-halt wallet authorized to activate the circuit breaker. Deactivation
remains admin-only and time-gated. Rotatable via `update_yielding_bank_config`.

fields.name: yielding_bank_id
docs: Identifier for the yield-bearing asset bank this carry position is allocated to

fields.name: shares
docs: Number of shares held in the yielding bank (converts to underlying via bank share price)

fields.name: tvl_usd
docs: Raw USD value of this token's share of the yielding bank, normalized to

fields.name: id
docs: Unique identifier for this bank, used in PDA derivation and referenced by token carry positions

fields.name: decimals
docs: Share precision for `total_shares` accounting and share-price math.
Canonically 8 so one whole UI share is priced in the shared TVL USD base unit.

fields.name: circuit_breaker
docs: When active, halts all activity except decrease_carry_position

fields.name: default_redemption_mint
docs: The mint that should be used as the default source when redeeming
(e.g. swapping from this mint into a debt mint during decrease_carry_position).

fields.name: time_created_ts
docs: Unix timestamp when this yielding bank was created.
